operator_stimulus.scope: Register and test the shared packet/path language across the three existing sources, keeping native and supplied tensor-doublet domains distinct.

coherence_obligations: Attachment transport: the same source/recovery/operation/reader grammar instantiated on native carriers.
Route/comparison compatibility: transport all native electron signed-sector certificates into explicit baryon tensor doublets.
Readout faithfulness: test whether original rank-one returns can carry that same nonabelian spin action.
problem: Does shared packet language mean a common typed interface, a conditional common spin-word action, or the same action already present on all unextended native returns?
bold_conjecture: A common source/recovery/operation/reader interface is realized natively; the complete 24-operation signed path calculus transports through both explicit tensor-doublet enlargements, while actual source actions and metric remain attached.
rivals: The models merely share packet notation without source-bound constructors or action squares.
The native rank-one proton and neutron returns already implement the same full nonabelian spinor action without enlargement.
A conditional shared logical dictionary selects a physical spin frame, lift sign or charge law.
The actual geometric spin lifts automatically belong to, or normalize, the finite shared dictionary in their retained frames.
native_grammar: Named source and metric; K,D with DK=I and KD=N at frozen return scope; admitted operation letters with encoding/decoding squares; source-bound execution word and retained readers. Identical grammar does not mean identical rank or operation dictionary.

conditional_grammar.baryon_carrier: C^36 tensor C^2 with K_tilde=K tensor I2 and D_tilde=D tensor I2
conditional_grammar.spin_action: S_U=I36 tensor U for the SAME24 matrices and normal-form tokens used by the electron
conditional_grammar.geometric_action: T_g=P_g tensor (+/-U_g), with P_g and both lift branches taken from the actual source receipts
conditional_grammar.naturality_target: T_g S_U K_tilde=K_tilde ((+/-U_g) U), with correct noncommutative order; no assertion that U_g U remains in the 24-element dictionary
conditional_grammar.normalization: Retain original baryon M and exact rho tags; no Euclidean replacement
conditional_grammar.archive: Words retain source identity and the explicit carrier-enlargement flag; endpoint normal forms do not erase them.

risky_tests: Native source K,D and operation squares instantiate the grammar for all three original carriers, with native ranks1/1/2 and distinct operation domains.
All24 SAME logical matrices preserve each enlarged baryon image, with decoder/encoder and original-metric squares; the inherited normalizer has exactly the same576 multiplication results.
All12 derived sector comparisons, all36 situated encounters, all8 three-direction critical-pair joins and their48 permutation routes attach to BOTH enlarged sources without erasing central sign.
For each of the three actual geometric source generators, BOTH spin-lift signs preserve the attached doublet encoding and compose in the declared order with every common logical operation.

Record exact membership and normalization counts of the actual geometric lifts against the finite shared dictionary; if closure fails, export a concrete conjugation residual rather than fitting a frame.
On each original rank-one return, the actual L/G/N commutator fixes K, while the requested anticommutation correction would negate K; export the nonzero residual.
Reject native spin mixing without a doublet flag and cross-source execution records; retain different words with equal endpoint matrices.

acceptance.shared_native_grammar: Constructed only if actual source maps and enabled operations instantiate the same typed interface.
acceptance.conditional_shared_path_language: Constructed only at explicitly enlarged carrier scope, with all signed comparisons and actual source attachments checked.
acceptance.unextended_native_full_spin_language: Rejected if rank-one/actual native-action residual excludes the same invertible nonabelian action; this is not rejection of the shared grammar.

failure_boundary: A failed source identity, metric square, action attachment or word comparison invalidates its claim. A failed finite-dictionary closure is retained as a scope boundary, not repaired by silently adding a frame or native operation.
